create_level_generator: create a LevelGenerator instance with a 10x10 map filled with floor tiles and hardfloor flag
add_object_to_map: add an apple object with percent symbol at coordinates (3, 4) on the generated level map
add_monster_to_map: add a hostile jackal monster at coordinates (5, 5) on the generated level map
generate_des_file: generate the complete NetHack description file string from the LevelGenerator with all added objects and monsters
add_mazewalk: add a random maze starting from the center of the map heading east using mazewalk
